title: Anomaly Detection
summary: Machine-learning methods for model-agnostic searches, from classification without labels to background templates and autoencoders.
---

Machine-learning methods for searches that do not assume a signal model, grouped by how they model the background. Entries were last checked against their papers in November 2026.

## Weak supervision {: #weak-supervision }

<div class="table-wrap"><table class="catalogue-table catalogue-entries"><thead><tr><th>Method</th><th>Idea</th><th>Supervision</th><th>Year</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr class="row" id="cwola"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cwola-detail">Classification without labels (CWoLa)</button></td><td>Classifier between two mixed samples</td><td>Weak</td><td>2017</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="cwola-detail"><td colspan="4">

Trains a classifier between two mixtures with different signal fractions; the optimal classifier between them is the optimal fully supervised one.

<tr class="row" id="cwola-hunting"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cwola-hunting-detail">CWoLa hunting</button></td><td>Signal region against its sidebands</td><td>Weak</td><td>2018</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="cwola-hunting-detail"><td colspan="4">

A bump hunt in which classifiers trained between a signal region and its sidebands enhance an unknown resonance with features uncorrelated with the resonant one.

<tr class="row-detail" id="tag-n-train-detail"><td colspan="4">

Uses a weak classifier on one of two sub-objects to build signal-rich and background-rich samples for a stronger classifier on the other.

<tr class="row-detail" id="boosted-decision-trees-detail"><td colspan="4">

Replaces neural networks by boosted decision trees in weakly supervised anomaly detection, which train faster and keep their performance with many noisy features.

## Background templates {: #background-templates }

<div class="table-wrap"><table class="catalogue-table catalogue-entries"><thead><tr><th>Method</th><th>Idea</th><th>Supervision</th><th>Year</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr class="row" id="anode"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="anode-detail">ANODE</button></td><td>Density ratio of data to interpolated sidebands</td><td>Unsupervised</td><td>2020</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="anode-detail"><td colspan="4">

Estimates the density of the data in the signal region and in the sidebands, interpolates the latter, and forms a likelihood ratio of data to background.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

<p class="row-links"><a href="papers.md#nachman-2020lpy">Paper</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.04990">arXiv</a><button type="button" class="cite-button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-cite="Nachman:2020lpy" data-file="anode">Cite</button><a class="cited-by" href="https://inspirehep.net/literature?q=refersto%3Arecid%3A1775739">Cited by</a></p>

<p class="row-label">References</p><ul class="row-refs"><li class="ref-cite"><span class="citation" data-key="Nachman:2020lpy" data-text="B. Nachman and D. Shih, “Anomaly Detection with Density Estimation”, Phys. Rev. D 101 (2020) 075042, arXiv:2001.04990.">B. Nachman and D. Shih, “Anomaly Detection with Density Estimation”, Phys. Rev. D 101 (2020) 075042, arXiv:2001.04990.</span> <button type="button" class="bib-copy" data-cite="Nachman:2020lpy">BibTeX</button></li></ul>

</td></tr>
<tr class="row" id="r-anode"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="r-anode-detail">R-ANODE</button></td><td>Signal flow fitted with background held fixed</td><td>Unsupervised</td><td>2023</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="r-anode-detail"><td colspan="4">

Fits a normalizing flow to the small signal component in the signal region while a sideband-trained background flow stays fixed.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

<p class="row-links"><a href="papers.md#das-2023bcj">Paper</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.11629">arXiv</a><button type="button" class="cite-button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-cite="Das:2023bcj" data-file="r-anode">Cite</button><a class="cited-by" href="https://inspirehep.net/literature?q=refersto%3Arecid%3A2738545">Cited by</a></p>

<p class="row-label">References</p><ul class="row-refs"><li class="ref-cite"><span class="citation" data-key="Das:2023bcj" data-text="R. Das, G. Kasieczka and D. Shih, “Residual ANODE”, arXiv:2312.11629.">R. Das, G. Kasieczka and D. Shih, “Residual ANODE”, arXiv:2312.11629.</span> <button type="button" class="bib-copy" data-cite="Das:2023bcj">BibTeX</button></li></ul>

</td></tr>
<tr class="row" id="salad"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="salad-detail">SALAD</button></td><td>Simulation reweighted to sideband data</td><td>Weak, with simulation</td><td>2020</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="salad-detail"><td colspan="4">

Reweights background simulation to the data in the sidebands, interpolates the reweighting into the signal region, and uses the reweighted simulation as background.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

<p class="row-links"><a href="papers.md#andreassen-2020nkr">Paper</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.05001">arXiv</a><a href="https://github.com/bnachman/DCTRHunting">Code</a><button type="button" class="cite-button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-cite="Andreassen:2020nkr" data-file="salad">Cite</button><a class="cited-by" href="https://inspirehep.net/literature?q=refersto%3Arecid%3A1775741">Cited by</a></p>

<p class="row-label">References</p><ul class="row-refs"><li class="ref-cite"><span class="citation" data-key="Andreassen:2020nkr" data-text="A. Andreassen, B. Nachman and D. Shih, “Simulation Assisted Likelihood-free Anomaly Detection”, Phys. Rev. D 101 (2020) 095004, arXiv:2001.05001.">A. Andreassen, B. Nachman and D. D 101 (2020) 095004, arXiv:2001.05001.</span> <button type="button" class="bib-copy" data-cite="Andreassen:2020nkr">BibTeX</button></li></ul>

</td></tr>
<tr class="row" id="cathode"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cathode-detail">CATHODE</button></td><td>Classifier against sampled background</td><td>Weak</td><td>2022</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="cathode-detail"><td colspan="4">

Samples background events from a sideband density estimator interpolated into the signal region and trains a classifier between them and the data.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

<p class="row-links"><a href="papers.md#hallin-2021wme">Paper</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.00546">arXiv</a><a href="https://github.com/HEPML-AnomalyDetection/CATHODE">Code</a><button type="button" class="cite-button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-cite="Hallin:2021wme" data-file="cathode">Cite</button><a class="cited-by" href="https://inspirehep.net/literature?q=refersto%3Arecid%3A1915354">Cited by</a></p>

<p class="row-label">References</p><ul class="row-refs"><li class="ref-cite"><span class="citation" data-key="Hallin:2021wme" data-text="A. Hallin et al., “Classifying anomalies through outer density estimation”, Phys. Rev. D 106 (2022) 055006, arXiv:2109.00546.">A. Hallin et al., “Classifying anomalies through outer density estimation”, Phys. Rev. D 106 (2022) 055006, arXiv:2109.00546.</span> <button type="button" class="bib-copy" data-cite="Hallin:2021wme">BibTeX</button></li></ul>

</td></tr>
<tr class="row" id="curtains"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="curtains-detail">CURTAINs</button></td><td>Sideband data mapped into the signal region</td><td>Weak</td><td>2023</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="curtains-detail"><td colspan="4">

Invertible networks conditioned on the resonant observable map sideband data into the signal region as the background template.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

<p class="row-links"><a href="papers.md#raine-2022hht">Paper</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.09470">arXiv</a><button type="button" class="cite-button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" data-cite="Raine:2022hht" data-file="curtains">Cite</button><a class="cited-by" href="https://inspirehep.net/literature?q=refersto%3Arecid%3A2054235">Cited by</a></p>

</td></tr>
<tr class="row" id="feta"><td><button type="button" class="row-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="feta-detail">FETA</button></td><td>Flow maps simulation to sideband data</td><td>Weak, with simulation</td><td>2023</td></tr>
<tr class="row-detail" id="feta-detail"><td colspan="4">

A flow conditioned on the resonant mass maps background simulation to sideband data and is interpolated into the signal region to give the template.

<p class="row-uses">Uses: <a href="datasets.md#lhc-olympics">LHC Olympics 2020</a></p>

## Autoencoders {: #autoencoders }
